parsed.name: 基于IVVI的电流源
parsed.description: 一种利用IVVI电压输出经转换电路产生可调电流的实验室偏置源，常用于为低温电子学、纳米器件或量子器件提供稳定电流偏置，并可通过换算或测量评估输出电流与负载电阻。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory bias source that uses an IVVI voltage output with a conversion circuit to generate adjustable current. It is commonly used to provide stable current bias for cryogenic electronics, nanodevices, or quantum devices, and to estimate or measure output current and load resistance.
